Give yourself large amounts of money

Don't put high numbers in the money variable or the game will crash I suggest rejoining after executing a few times

local money = 100

task.wait(1)
for i = 1, money do
    task.spawn(function()
        fireproximityprompt(workspace.LootableItems.MayorsSafe.SearchPrompt)
    end)
end
